name: Let the Team Shine
definition: Empower your colleagues and amplify what the team achieved rather than what you achieved.

rows.under: Reports it as yours, because you were the one presenting.
rows.justRight: Names the people who did it, specifically, in front of the people who decide.
rows.over: Distributes credit so evenly that real contribution becomes invisible.

rows.situation: When you could do it faster yourself
rows.under: Does it yourself. The team learns nothing and depends on you.
rows.justRight: Gives it away with the context needed to succeed, and absorbs the slower first attempt.
rows.over: Delegates work you are uniquely placed to do, and the team pays for your absence.

rows.under: Notices, and waits for them to ask.
rows.justRight: Goes and unblocks them, then makes sure the block does not reform.
rows.over: Steps in so early that people stop trying to solve anything alone.

rows.situation: When their idea is nearly as good as yours
rows.under: Argues yours through on the strength of your position.
rows.justRight: Takes theirs when the difference is small. Ownership is worth more than the margin.
rows.over: Never advocates your own view, and the team loses your judgment.

rows.situation: When leadership only ever sees you
rows.under: Enjoys it, and lets the team stay invisible.
rows.justRight: Puts the people doing the work in front of the people who decide.
rows.over: Pushes people into visibility they are not ready for, and lets them fail in public.
